general.notes: Pair product: SO-SFP-1000BASE-BX80D-5157 (TX/RX 1510nm/1570nm) and SO-SFP-1000BASE-BX80D-5751 (TX/RX 1570nm/1510nm). Footnote 1) applies to -5157 transmit wavelength 1504–1517nm and receiver wavelength range 1550–1590nm. Footnote 2) applies to -5751 transmit wavelength 1564–1577nm and receiver wavelength range 1490–1530nm. Footnote 3) average power for TX output and RX min/overload. Footnote 4) RX min input power and overload @ 1.25Gbps, BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹², PRBS 2⁷-1, back-to-back. Power budget 8–26dB. Dispersion penalty max 1dB (no paired penalized metric for penalty objects). Extended operating temperature -20°C to +85°C (-E variants); storage -40°C to +85°C. Power consumption stated as < 1.0W.
general.suggestions: Consider list types for temp_min_c/temp_max_c when C-temp and E-temp variants are on one datasheet. Map power budget (8–26dB) and dispersion penalty max 1dB to dedicated fields if needed.
